goal: 建立只含 identity、chat、simc、ops 的干净产品迁移链，并让 Mini Bearer 与 Web HttpOnly Session 安全解析到同一正式内部 user_id。
userValue: 同一微信用户可在小程序和 Web 使用独立登录会话访问同一个账号和同一份 Chat/SimC 历史，同时不同用户、不同微信应用上下文和不同 credential transport 不会被误合并。
nonGoals: 本阶段不实现正式 Chat 或 SimC 业务 API，也不精简双端路由。
本阶段不迁移 legacy Chat/SimC 数据，不切换生产 DSN、Nginx、systemd 或公网流量。
当前容量和独立恢复 gate 未通过时，不创建云端 chickenbro_prod、不写入 PostgreSQL、不停止服务、不删除数据库或目录。
本阶段不迁移旧 auth session、prototype owner、OpenID 明文、Cookie、Bearer、ticket、verifier、session_key 或第三方凭据。
本阶段不把静态 SQL 测试、mock、dry-run、HTTP 200、进程 active 或 blocked candidate 描述为 Phase 2 完成。

mustChange: product-only PostgreSQL migration lineage with exactly identity, chat, simc and ops owners
formal WeChat identity uniqueness by provider, app_context and provider_subject
independent Mini Bearer and Web Cookie session issue, resolution and revocation
unambiguous Principal resolution with exact Origin and Web double-submit CSRF protection
redacted auth audit events with no provider subject or credential material
capacity and independent-recovery guarded chickenbro_prod provisioning dry run
task-scoped Strict requirement, evidence and manifest
mustNotChange: legacy wow_test contents, connections, schema or write availability
production and candidate Nginx, systemd, timers, ports, DSNs or traffic
current Mini/Web production routes and prototype compatibility runtime
Chat, SimC and Worker formal business behavior reserved for Phases 3 and 4
Active Manifest, cloud SimulationCraft runtime pointer, TLS or credentials
any database, deployment, service or directory selected for later legacy cleanup
riskUnknown: The cloud inventory is point-in-time and must be refreshed before any candidate mutation.
The current root has about 8.58 GB free while non-template databases total about 39.28 GB; safe candidate coexistence is not established.
No independent backup device and successful restore identity has been verified for this phase.
The existing identity foundation uses provider_subject without app_context and contains prototype compatibility methods that must not leak into the clean product schema.
evidenceRequired: test-first exact schema and forbidden-owner checks plus optional isolated PostgreSQL integration
same-user cross-session, cross-app non-merge, conflict and independent revocation tests
mixed credential, wrong transport, exact Origin, CSRF and redacted audit tests
provisioning behavior tests and mutation-free dry-run output
candidate database identity, zero forbidden schemas and rollback only after capacity plus independent recovery gates are green
local CR, secret scan and one complete task-scoped Harness packet

engineeringHealth.reason: Identity, schema and provisioning are high-trust surfaces. Local implementation is authorized, while candidate apply remains fail-closed behind fresh capacity, independent backup and restore proof.

acceptanceEvidence: python3 -m unittest tests.product_schema_test tests.app_identity_application_test tests.app_identity_repository_test tests.app_identity_api_test tests.app_csrf_test -v

decisionLog.decision: Phase 1 control plane is sealed at local_verified with a reachable read-only cloud snapshot and zero runtime mutation; Phase 2 local implementation can begin.
candidateDatabaseProvisioningAuthorized remains false until a refreshed inventory, sufficient capacity, an independent backup device and a successful restore identity are all recorded.
Production cutover and destructive cleanup remain separately unauthorized regardless of local or candidate Phase 2 results.
